method.workload: Frozen nine-placed-stone state; 49 inventory objects; depth 3; 512 iterations; seed 0; progressive widening; 4 CPU result workers.
method.timing: search.search only; one sequential isolated process per case; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; one measurement per case.
method.controls: whole128: evaluation/native/placement limits 128/128/128; serial32: 128/128/32 without overlap; pipeline32: 128/128/32 with overlap; pipeline-native32: 128/32/32; current32: original 32/32/32 profile.
method.overlap: Pairwise intersection of sequential CPU result-processing and CUDA _run intervals. _run includes native calls and immediate return handling, not pure device-kernel duration. Stage wall totals overlap and must not be added.
method.semantics: Tree digest includes ordered incoming actions, resulting object poses, priors, rewards, visits, value_sum, failed/terminal flags, rejection reasons and child ordering. Timing diagnostics, observations and trajectories are not hashed; native tests cover streamed trajectory/observation parity.
method.limits: Single scene and seed; not a universal speedup or search-quality comparison. The production-profile comparison also changes MCTS allocation; only the controlled 128-limit runs isolate execution scheduling.
